notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Sections were omitted in the general amendment of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act of 1965, Pub. L. 89–10, by Pub. L. 103–382, title I, § 101, Oct. 20, 1994, 108 Stat. 3519. Section 3271, Pub. L. 89–10, title VI, § 6201, as added Pub. L. 100–297, title I, § 1001, Apr. 28, 1988, 102 Stat. 273; amended Pub. L. 101–250, § 4, Mar. 6, 1990, 104 Stat. 97, contained provisions general to this subchapter. Section 3272, Pub. L. 89–10, title VI, § 6202, as added Pub. L. 100–297, title I, § 1001, Apr. 28, 1988, 102 Stat. 273, defined terms used in this subchapter.
